title: Community Minecraft mods spotlight
summary: Two community-made Minecraft mods, OfflinePlayers and TwinSession, were highlighted.
description: TheySix shared two useful mods created by Mister Fish after testing their features and performance.

body.text: OfflinePlayers allows a server player to leave an offline copy behind for AFK tasks, with inventory and experience handled when the player returns.
TwinSession allows multiple connections using the same Minecraft account, making it useful for testing and managing multiple in-game tasks.
